This limited edition timepiece was created in a quantity of 500 pieces to celebrate Tag Heuer’s long standing partnership with the Indy 500 and was produced exclusively for the race. The watch is completely centred around the Indy 500 theming, with the base of the dial featuring an exclusive black grained effect to represent the texture of the racetrack. In addition, the chapter ring of the dial is coloured in red to honour the Indy’s iconic brickwork start/finish line, as well as being a nod towards the Indy’s “Brickyard” nickname. Gold accents can also be seen throughout the dial as a representation of the Indy’s logo, as well as the appearance of the famous Pagoda Tower that houses the race printed on the chronograph sub-dial. The dial is surrounded by a black tachymetre bezel whereby the “tachymetre” wording has been replaced with “INDY 500”.Of which is sat upon a 43 stainless steel case, which is fitted to a stainless steel bracelet.
